title: Result Sanity Verdict
description: ANALYZE-stage hard-gate artifact (the graph.yaml ANALYZE blocking gate). Output of result-sanity-checker. Mechanically screens a result_summary for NaN/Inf, out-of-range metric values (per domain profile), and leakage-smell (an implausible jump over baseline) BEFORE any reviewer reads the numbers. verdict BLOCK halts. Derived mechanically from sanity_checker.py. R3 C4 (2026-08-07): notes carries the input result_summary's sources_read, so a worker's honest provenance record is not silently dropped by a screen that otherwise reads only findings[].value/baseline_value.
